title: Compliance Note — Identity Re-Verification Charge on Name Amendments (Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing)
content:
A name amendment on a Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing certificate carries an identity re-verification charge that follows the state responses on the filing's record within the past month.

| State response on the filing's record within the past month | How the certificate travels | Identity re-verification charge |
|---|---|---|
| A rejection for a name mismatch, a date of birth mismatch or a license number mismatch | Paper mail | 6.00 |
| A rejection for a name mismatch, a date of birth mismatch or a license number mismatch | Electronic transmission | 3.00 |
| No such rejection | Either | None |

**Which rejections.** Only the three identity codes count: name mismatch, date of birth mismatch and license number mismatch. A case not found, policy number format or form type mismatch rejection does not.

**Window.** "Within the past month" covers state responses whose response date is less than one whole month before today, whole months being counted from the response date to today.

**Hypothetical cases (today 30 June).**
- Electronic certificate; a name mismatch rejection dated 12 June: 3.00.
- Paper-mail certificate; a date of birth mismatch rejection dated 31 May: 6.00.
- Paper-mail certificate; a license number mismatch rejection dated 30 May (one whole month ago): none.
- Any certificate; a case not found rejection last week: none.
